Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 18:03:00 -0800
Subject: Evening interleaved demo — lane assignments & fallback plan

Hi all —

Thanks again for booking time for the multi-prospect evening session. Quick proposal below for how we run the 75-minute block so each prospect gets a concise walk-through while we keep the bridge tidy:

- Start: 18:30 PT (we'll open 5 min early for audio checks)
- Format: three 20-minute lanes (15m demo + 5m Q&A) interleaved with short transitions.
- Hosts: Ben -> BrightTribe, Neha -> Oakridge, Sofia -> general product run / wrap-up.
- Fallback: if GPU-backed hands-on fails, we'll immediately drop to a hosted demo variant (lower latency, same prompts) — Neha will own fallback trigger.
- Capacity: limit to 40 total; breakout rooms available if customers request deeper dives.

Attachments: interleaved-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda), bridge-ops-runbook.docx (ops checklist).

Can you confirm the time and host order? Lena / Samir, do you prefer a different start time?

Cheers,
Sofia
